title: A $p = 2$ dichotomy for uniform Riesz transform bounds on stratified Lie groups
summary: Let $\mathbb{G}$ be a stratified Lie group and $\mathcal L$ be its sub-Laplacian. We prove that the full horizontal Riesz transform $\nabla_{H} \mathcal L^{-1/2}$ is of weak type $(1,1)$ on real-valued functions, with constant at most $2$. In particular, the constant is independent of the horizontal dimension, the homogeneous dimension, the step, and the underlying group structure of $\mathbb{G}$.
